text:
ella_ops: Brief update 1: we opened an on-demand A100x tranche in eu-west-2 (London zone-2) to cover capacity while zone-1 undergoes scheduled NIC firmware maintenance.

sam_infra: Config added: `infra-config/services/dedicated/pools/eu-west-2/a100x-ondemand-zone2.yaml`

```yaml
pool_name: a100x-ondemand-eu-west-2-z2
capacity_gpus: 40
mode: on_demand
allocation_policy: best_effort
preemption: allowed_for_reserved
billing: on_demand_rate
note: "temporary handoff while zone-1 NIC firmware maintenance is active"
```

deploy-bot: infra-config v1.45 deployed to prod by sam_infra :38UTC deploy id `deploy-2026-03-29-1338` :rocket:

omar_ukops: London ops are performing NVLink and RDMA validation on the new nodes now. Any customer jobs placed on the tranche will be monitored for small packet drops. Posting perf graphs to the console.

priya_support: CS copy for status page drafted: "We enabled temporary A100x on-demand capacity in London (zone-2) to reduce reservation delays while we perform firmware maintenance in zone-1. No action required." Will post to #support after legal review. :memo:

sophie_sales: For invited enterprise customers who rely on zone-1 reserved capacity, we flagged them and offered to migrate their fallback reservations to the on-demand tranche if they request it.

sam_infra: Ops safety hooks: auto-evacuate policy if `gpu_temp_p95>87C` OR `rdma_pkt_drop_rate>0.05%` for more than 10m. If evacuation triggers, we will re-route new allocations back to zone-1 and page oncall.

ella_ops: Customer impact: running reserved contracts in zone-1 unaffected. This tranche accepts new on-demand requests and will also serve as a temporary placement target for small PLG reservations to reduce queue times. Burst pricing applies.

priya_support: Will add FAQ lines: "Will my running job be moved?" -> No, we'll only move new allocations; "Will billing change?" -> On-demand rates apply to new allocations in the tranche.

omar_ukops: Note from maintenance: NIC firmware update start 02:00 UTC, expected 4-hour window. If maintenance extends past 6h we'll open additional on-demand nodes and notify teams.

sam_infra: Monitoring panels: `a100x_ondemand_fill`, `rdma_pkt_drop_rate`, `queue_wait_p50_p95`. Lowered alert thresholds for the first 12h. Auto-scale scripts ready to add 16 GPUs if queue_age_p95>20m for >15m.

status-bot: Status updated: "Temporary A100x on-demand tranche enabled in eu-west-2 zone-2 for scheduled NIC firmware maintenance in zone-1. Monitoring active."

ella_ops: Rollback plan: drain-once-maintenance-complete -> remove tranche entry from infra-config -> redeploy. Tentative window 43h; will post a closure note when maintenance completes.

sophie_sales: Sent emails to impacted accounts offering a 10% credit for any job performance regressions during the maintenance window. Finance okayed the gesture.

priya_support: Posting the status update now. If customers ask about cross-zone data residency, escalate to security/legal.

ella_ops: Thanks team. Please paste any anomalies here and we'll include in the post-maintenance note. :white_check_mark:
